clips.title: The story
paras: This leg of the investigation finally confirms the sinister truth connecting the elusive tutor to Darkshire's records. Clerk Daltry successfully matches the handwriting found on the recovered documents to Stalvan Mistmantle, prompting an immediate report to Commander Althea Ebonlocke. It marks the moment the Night Watch's suspicions harden into undeniable fact.

After combing through distant manors, inns, and municipal archives across the human kingdoms, the fragmented trail returns to Darkshire's town hall. Clerk Daltry compares the bloodstained journal page against the signatures in the Town Registry. The result is unequivocal: the penmanship belongs to Stalvan Mistmantle, giving the Night Watch the hard evidence needed to treat the matter as an urgent local threat.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Let Commander Ebonlocke know immediately that the handwriting matched, friend! Her suspicions were correct!

clips.title: Completion
paras: I knew it! Fine work, friend.
